core_meaning.primary_meaning: Sa-idah is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Idah; happy, fortunate (feminine). Sa”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Sa-idah corresponds to the Arabic form سَعِيدَة (Arabic root س ع د (s-ʿ-d); سَعِيدَة (Saʿīda)). Its core sense is sa'idah; happy, fortunate (feminine). Sa'idah is Arabic سَعِيدَة (Saʿīda) 'happy, fortunate' (feminine), from the root س ع د (s-ʿ-d). The source gloss 'Happy' is consistent. CRITICAL SOURCE ERROR: the source labelled the gender unisex; documented usage is predominantly female.
